audience: peer reviewers of a machine-learning for materials paper

output_contract.methods_section: markdown text of the Methods and Experiments section, ready for the author to edit
output_contract.parameter_table: table of parameter name, value, unit, target and source
output_contract.evidence_map: per-fact source locator so a reviewer can re-open every number
output_contract.coverage_report: status of the six required elements (steps, setup, parameters, datasets, baselines, reproducibility and limitations)
output_contract.open_questions: items only the author can confirm, each naming the file to open

notes: TOY CASE. Every file under materials/ is written for this example; no real experiment was run. The numbers are internally consistent on purpose so the audit can be exercised in both directions.
